name: My Business
description: Automated business operations powered by Paperclip AI agent orchestration.
mission: Streamline and automate key business processes using coordinated AI agents.

agents.name: Strategist
agents.description: Plans company strategy, creates and prioritizes issues, delegates to engineers, reviews progress.

agents.name: Builder
agents.description: Executes technical tasks — writes code, fixes bugs, builds features, runs tests.

agents.name: Reviewer
agents.description: Reviews completed work, checks acceptance criteria, runs quality checks, approves or requests changes.

agents.name: Analyst
agents.description: Researches market data, competitor analysis, customer feedback, and business intelligence.

routines.name: daily-standup
routines.description: CEO reviews open issues, reprioritizes, and assigns work for the day.

routines.name: weekly-review
routines.description: CEO summarizes weekly progress, blockers, and plans for next week.

routines.name: qa-sweep
routines.description: QA agent reviews all issues in 'review' status.
